description:
Get an access point's churn

An Access Point's joiner / mover / leaver activity over a period: a daily category series with derived net growth, period totals, and the 'won from / lost to' counterpart breakdown. Joiners are first-ever serving seats (from 2026-08-02 onward, first-full-deep-sweep completion); movers change Provider (both sides resolved to the current identity); leavers deregister while served. Defaults to the trailing 30 days.

A Vendor key (`v-<slug>`) returns the same shape for the Vendor, from a daily comparison of its membership. Movement is counted from `churn_since`; there is no history before it. A counterpart is a Provider or another Vendor (`kind`). `match_totals` and the `newly_matched` / `no_longer_matched` series count membership changes with no real event behind them (a signal appeared or disappeared): they are a data-quality figure, not movement, and are never in `net_growth`.

For a Provider key, `counterpart_flow` gives each mover side (out, in) its top counterpart with its share and the effective number of counterparts, over the requested period. The share is null under 25 movers on that side and the effective number under 100. A Vendor key has no `counterpart_flow`.

PLATFORM MOVES. A mover is a platform move when the platform that serves the participant stayed and only the certificate Seat changed: it is not a customer decision. The verdict is per DIRECTED provider pair (from → to), over all its movers since 2026-08-02, with one of two reasons (`same_host`, `sub_provider`): at least 90% of the movers whose endpoint host can be compared (5 or more, and at least 50% of all movers of the pair) kept their endpoint host, or at least 90% of 25 or more movers still carry, at the new provider, the sub-provider brand of the provider they left. It is a CURRENT judgment, computed again on every rollup cycle. For a Provider key, the movers of a platform-move pair are in `platform_won` / `platform_lost` of the counterpart and not in its `won` / `lost`; the flag is per direction (counterpart → Provider, Provider → counterpart). `totals.platform_in` / `totals.platform_out` are their sums. `totals.movers_in`, `totals.movers_out`, `net_growth` and the daily series still count all movers. A Vendor key is not changed: its counterparts have no platform fields.

from.description: Inclusive period start, `YYYY-MM-DD` UTC. Defaults to 29 days before `to`.

key.description: The Provider key (e.g. `c-tickstar`), or a Vendor key (`v-exact`).

to.description: Inclusive period end, `YYYY-MM-DD` UTC. Defaults to today.

name: get_access_point_churn
